Python

Use Python to read local data, build queries, and inspect or export results. Admitted queries run in ShardLoom. Unsupported work returns a diagnostic without fallback execution.

Run a local query
Section titled “Run a local query”

Create the small CSV in the getting-started walkthrough before running this example. The public run() report exposes the result and native execution evidence.

import shardloom as sl


ctx = sl.context()
result = (
    ctx.read("data/orders.csv")
       .filter(sl.col("status") == "paid")
       .limit(10)
       .run()
)


print(result.envelope.field_int("output_row_count"))
print(result.envelope.human_text)
print(result.fallback_attempted, result.external_engine_invoked)

ctx.read(path) infers local adapters for .csv, .json, .jsonl, .ndjson, .parquet, .arrow, .ipc, .feather, .avro, .orc, and .vortex. CSV, flat JSON/JSONL/NDJSON, generated rows, and scoped local Vortex inputs are the default public examples. Parquet, Arrow IPC/Feather, Avro, and ORC are scoped local-format surfaces when the matching feature-gated build is present; otherwise ShardLoom returns deterministic adapter blockers without fallback execution.

Reuse And Export
Section titled “Reuse And Export”

Python contexts can retain a local worker to avoid per-call CLI startup. Automatic preparation reuses an unchanged source only when its schema and artifact identities match. Each query still has fresh execution state; a prepared artifact is not a cache of query results.

Admitted flat results can use write_vortex, write_parquet, write_arrow_ipc, write_avro, write_orc, write_csv, write_json, and write_jsonl through the shared native result and sink contracts. Feature gates, supported types, and result limits apply. See runtime and I/O and the user-surface index.

Consume results in batches
Section titled “Consume results in batches”

The accepted local source branch adds iter_batches() for admitted results and from_batches() for explicitly typed resident input. Hosted integration is pending; published v0.4.0 packages predate these additions.

def orders():
    yield [{"order_id": 1, "amount": 12.5}]
    yield [{"order_id": 2, "amount": None}]


frame = sl.from_batches(
    orders, schema={"order_id": "int64", "amount": "float64"},
)
with frame.iter_batches(batch_rows=1024) as batches:
    for batch in batches:
        print(batch.result_rows)
    assert batches.report is not None

Input admits nullable Int64, finite Float64, booleans and UTF8 strings with an explicit schema. Each input batch contains at most 2,048 row mappings and an 8 MiB frame, with up to 128 fields and 4,096 batches per source. Total native input must fit the query memory grant. A factory, as above, supplies fresh input for repeated calls; an iterable can be consumed once.

Requesting the next result batch acknowledges the preceding one. Use the context manager when stopping early, and treat delivered batches as provisional until the final report is present after full exhaustion. Prepare compatibility file inputs explicitly to Vortex before batch consumption. See resource boundaries.

Next steps
Section titled “Next steps”

See the examples for preparation, bounded collection, writes, and blocker inspection. The limitations page describes current coverage gaps.

records.contents:
"""Verify the tested PR head and its source bridge before/after a hosted merge."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import subprocess
import campaign_common as c

HEAD = "8873e261588ff29001253f4e73afb977e44c30cc"
BASE = "4ba9053205fa98da2183d42bb15e08543dba70cc"
GH = "/opt/homebrew/bin/gh"
REPO = "depsilon/shardloom"
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=("premerge", "postmerge"), required=True)
parser.add_argument("--attempt", type=int, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.attempt > 0


def run(*command):
    return subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=c.ROOT, text=True, timeout=60).strip()


def pr(number):
    return json.loads(run(GH, "pr", "view", str(number), "--repo", REPO, "--json",
        "number,url,state,isDraft,headRefOid,baseRefOid,mergeCommit,mergedAt,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup,reviews,comments"))


observed = pr(1526)
baseline = pr(1525)
query = '''query { repository(owner: "depsilon", name: "shardloom") {
  pullRequest(number: 1526) {
    reviewThreads(first: 100) { nodes { id isResolved isOutdated
      comments(first: 100) { nodes { body url author { login } }
        pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } }
    reviews(last: 100) { nodes { state body submittedAt commit { oid } author { login } }
      pageInfo { hasPreviousPage } }
    comments(last: 100) { nodes { id body url author { login } }
      pageInfo { hasPreviousPage } }
  }
} }'''
reviews = json.loads(run(GH, "api", "graphql", "-f", "query=" + query))
runs = json.loads(run(GH, "api", "repos/" + REPO
    + "/actions/runs?event=pull_request&head_sha=" + HEAD + "&per_page=100"))
prefix = f"resource-hosted-{args.stage}-{args.attempt}"
snapshot = {"pr": observed, "baseline_pr": baseline, "reviews": reviews,
    "workflow_runs": runs, "observed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
c.write(c.OUT / (prefix + "-snapshot.json"), snapshot)
assert not c.git("status", "--porcelain"), "acceptance requires the clean tested tree"
assert observed["headRefOid"] == HEAD and not observed["isDraft"]
assert baseline["state"] == "MERGED" and baseline["mergeCommit"]["oid"] == BASE
expected = {row["name"] for row in baseline["statusCheckRollup"]}
assert len(expected) == 39
for workflow in (".github/workflows/ci.yml", ".github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml"):
    assert c.git("show", BASE + ":" + workflow) == c.git("show", HEAD + ":" + workflow)
checks = observed["statusCheckRollup"]
assert len(checks) == len(expected) and {row["name"] for row in checks} == expected
assert all(row["status"] == "COMPLETED" and row["conclusion"] == "SUCCESS"
           for row in checks), [(row["name"], row["status"], row["conclusion"])
                                for row in checks if row["conclusion"] != "SUCCESS"]
assert runs["total_count"] == 2
assert {row["name"] for row in runs["workflow_runs"]} == {"CI", "CodeQL Analysis"}
assert all(row["head_sha"] == HEAD and row["status"] == "completed"
           and row["conclusion"] == "success" for row in runs["workflow_runs"])
assert "errors" not in reviews
review = reviews["data"]["repository"]["pullRequest"]
assert not review["reviewThreads"]["pageInfo"]["hasNextPage"]
assert not review["reviews"]["pageInfo"]["hasPreviousPage"]
assert not review["comments"]["pageInfo"]["hasPreviousPage"]
assert not review["reviewThreads"]["nodes"], "new review threads require inspection"
assert not review["reviews"]["nodes"], "new submitted reviews require inspection"
comments = review["comments"]["nodes"]
assert len(comments) == 2
assert {row["author"]["login"] for row in comments} == {
    "chatgpt-codex-connector", "cloudflare-workers-and-pages"}
for row in comments:
    if row["author"]["login"] == "chatgpt-codex-connector":
        assert row["body"].startswith("You have reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews.")
    else:
        assert "Deployment successful!" in row["body"] and HEAD[:8] in row["body"]
        assert "https://5d4137bc-shardloom.djheinrich.workers.dev" in row["body"]

source = c.read(c.OUT / "integration-repair-checks-2/summary.json")
build = c.read(c.OUT / "combined-build-1.json")
acceptance = c.read(c.OUT / "combined-final-acceptance-1.json")
assert source["status"] == "passed" and len(source["source_hashes"]) == 935
assert c.source_hashes() == source["source_hashes"]
assert len(build["source_hashes"]) == 935
changed = sorted(name for name in set(build["source_hashes"]) | set(source["source_hashes"])
                 if build["source_hashes"].get(name) != source["source_hashes"].get(name))
assert changed == ["shardloom-vortex/src/vortex_ingest_pipeline_pressure_tests.rs"]
assert changed == source["changed_source_assets"]
assert source["production_source_assets_unchanged"]
assert acceptance["status"] == "passed_local_engine"
assert acceptance["source_identity_sha256"] == build["source_identity_sha256"]
assert c.sha(build["binary"]) == build["binary_sha256"] == acceptance["binary_sha256"]
index = c.read(c.ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-engine-acceptance-2026-10-06.json")
for unit in index["units"].values():
    packet = unit["acceptance"]
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / packet["packet"]) == packet["packet_sha256"]
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / unit["portable_inspection"]) == unit["portable_inspection_sha256"]
for key in ("documentation_receipt", "integration_adjustments"):
    record = index[key]
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / record["path"]) == record["sha256"]
    receipt = c.read(c.ROOT / record["path"])
    archive = receipt["archive"]
    assert c.sha(c.ROOT / archive["path"]) == archive["sha256"]
assert c.read(c.OUT / "documentation-browser-final-2.json")["status"] == "passed"
assert not index["broader_roadmap_complete"] and not index["package_published"]

if args.stage == "premerge":
    assert observed["state"] == "OPEN" and observed["mergeStateStatus"] == "CLEAN"
    assert observed["baseRefOid"] == BASE and c.git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == HEAD
    assert c.git("ls-remote", "--heads", "origin", "main").split()[0] == BASE
    merge = None
else:
    assert observed["state"] == "MERGED" and observed["mergedAt"]
    merge = observed["mergeCommit"]["oid"]
    assert c.git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == merge
    assert c.git("rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", merge).split() == [merge, BASE, HEAD]
    assert c.git("rev-parse", merge + "^{tree}") == c.git("rev-parse", HEAD + "^{tree}")
    assert c.git("ls-remote", "--heads", "origin", "main").split()[0] == merge

result = {"status": "passed_" + args.stage, "pr": 1526, "head": HEAD, "base": BASE,
    "merge_commit": merge, "successful_hosted_checks": len(checks),
    "hosted_check_names": sorted(expected), "runtime_commit": index["runtime_commit"],
    "integration_source_assets_verified": 935, "runtime_source_assets_unchanged": 934,
    "test_only_source_adjustment": changed,
    "integration_source_identity_sha256": source["integration_source_identity_sha256"],
    "runtime_binary_sha256": acceptance["binary_sha256"],
    "snapshot_sha256": c.sha(c.OUT / (prefix + "-snapshot.json")),
    "source_bridge_sha256": c.sha(c.OUT / "integration-repair-checks-2/summary.json"),
    "local_engine_acceptance_sha256": c.sha(c.OUT / "combined-final-acceptance-1.json"),
    "hosted_automated_review": "unavailable_account_review_limit",
    "hosted_submitted_reviews": 0, "unresolved_review_threads": 0,
    "broader_roadmap_complete": False, "package_publication_attempted": False,
    "driver_sha256": c.sha(__file__)}
c.write(c.OUT / (prefix + ".json"), result)
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)

"""Archive the merged finite unit's hosted identity and production observations."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import campaign_common as c

EVIDENCE = c.ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/evidence"
HEAD = "8873e261588ff29001253f4e73afb977e44c30cc"
MERGE = "281056ca95daa86cc1376d4eb2c4d0b8714ae8ae"
assert c.git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == MERGE
assert c.source_hashes() == c.read(c.OUT / "integration-repair-checks-2/summary.json")["source_hashes"]
pre = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-premerge-1.json")
post = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-postmerge-1.json")
assert pre["status"] == "passed_premerge" and post["status"] == "passed_postmerge"
assert pre["head"] == post["head"] == HEAD and post["merge_commit"] == MERGE
assert pre["successful_hosted_checks"] == post["successful_hosted_checks"] == 39
for stage, record in (("premerge", pre), ("postmerge", post)):
    assert c.sha(c.OUT / f"resource-hosted-{stage}-1-snapshot.json") == record["snapshot_sha256"]
preview = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-preview-1.json")
production = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-production-1.json")
preview_link = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-preview-link-1.json")
production_link = c.read(c.OUT / "resource-hosted-production-link-1.json")
assert production["url"] == "https://shardloom.io/field-guide/python-surface/#consume-results-in-batches"
assert preview["fullBody"] == production["fullBody"]
assert preview_link["resourceText"] == production_link["resourceText"]
assert production_link["url"] == "https://shardloom.io/field-guide/runtime-and-io/#resources-and-recovery"
checks = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
    "/opt/homebrew/bin/gh", "api", "repos/depsilon/shardloom/commits/" + MERGE
    + "/check-runs?per_page=100"], cwd=c.ROOT, text=True, timeout=45))
deployments = [row for row in checks["check_runs"] if row["name"] == "Workers Builds: shardloom"]
assert len(deployments) == 1
deployment = deployments[0]
assert deployment["status"] == "completed" and deployment["conclusion"] == "success"
assert deployment["head_sha"] == MERGE
deployment_path = c.OUT / "resource-production-deployment-1.json"
if deployment_path.exists():
    assert c.read(deployment_path) == deployment
else:
    c.write(deployment_path, deployment)
names = [
    "resource-hosted-premerge-1.json", "resource-hosted-premerge-1-snapshot.json",
    "resource-hosted-postmerge-1.json", "resource-hosted-postmerge-1-snapshot.json",
    "resource-hosted-preview-1.json", "resource-hosted-preview-link-1.json",
    "resource-hosted-production-1.json", "resource-hosted-production-link-1.json",
    "resource-production-deployment-1.json", "verify_resource_hosted.py",
    "build_resource_hosted_receipt.py",
]
records = []
for name in names:
    data = (c.OUT / name).read_bytes()
    records.append({"name": name, "bytes": len(data),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        "contents": json.loads(data) if name.endswith(".json") else data.decode()})
images = []
for surface in ("preview", "production"):
    source = c.OUT / f"resource-hosted-{surface}-1.jpg"
    target = EVIDENCE / f"native-engine-{surface}-2026-10-07.jpg"
    if not target.exists():
        with target.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(source.read_bytes())
    assert c.sha(target) == c.sha(source)
    images.append({"path": target.name, "bytes": target.stat().st_size, "sha256": c.sha(target)})
receipt = {"schema_version": "shardloom.native_engine_hosted_acceptance.v1",
    "status": "passed_hosted_integration", "pr_url": "https://github.com/depsilon/shardloom/pull/1526",
    "head": HEAD, "merge_commit": MERGE, "successful_pr_checks": 39,
    "merge_tree_equals_accepted_head": True, "integration_source_assets_verified": 935,
    "production_source_assets_unchanged": True, "test_only_source_adjustment": post["test_only_source_adjustment"],
    "integration_source_identity_sha256": post["integration_source_identity_sha256"],
    "runtime_binary_sha256": post["runtime_binary_sha256"],
    "review": "Primary adversarial review and complete local acceptance preceded the merge. Hosted automated review was unavailable because of the account review limit. There were no submitted reviews or unresolved review threads; no independent approval is claimed.",
    "website": "The merged production deployment succeeded. Ordinary-browser checks verified the batch page's complete rendered text matches the accepted preview and the resource link opens the matching resource contract. These historical observations retain the pending-integration label; subsequent status documentation records the completed merge. Complete deployed HTML byte identity is not claimed.",
    "temporary_tabs_closed": True, "package_publication_attempted": False,
    "broader_roadmap_complete": False, "broad_engine_speedup_claim": False,
    "assembly_note": "The first assembly attempt rejected its own literal path-privacy guard in the embedded helper. No JSON receipt was written; the original helper is retained locally. The corrected guard verifies the same forbidden path prefixes without embedding those prefixes in its own source. Previously copied images and the deployment record are reused only after exact equality checks.",
    "records": records, "images": images}
serialized = json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
assert "/" + "Users" + "/" not in serialized and "/" + "home" + "/" not in serialized
path = EVIDENCE / "native-engine-hosted-2026-10-07.json"
with path.open("x") as stream:
    stream.write(serialized)
assert json.loads(path.read_text()) == receipt
print(json.dumps({"status": receipt["status"], "sha256": c.sha(path),
    "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "records": len(records), "images": len(images)}), flush=True)
